title: Venture Registry Schema
description: Validates the venture registry — the machine-readable representation of ventures formally admitted by Founder Office determination under the Corporate Venture Governance architecture (blueprint + FD-V1 + FD-V2). Registry entries record admitted governance facts; they never create venture status, authority, capability grants, readiness, or history. Constants and enums below encode FD-V1/FD-V9/FD-V10 invariants (ventures are not separate legal entities, delegated authority derives from the parent through the charter, capability sharing exists only through explicit grant, lifecycle is per-dimension, graduation is never automatic, success is fulfillment of chartered purpose) and FD-V2 register-topology invariants (the parent determinations register is the single institutional-plane register; venture operational records are authoritative only within delegated authority; crossing planes requires an explicit institutional-plane act; authority follows the governing plane of the fact, never repository location).

parent.description: The parent organization. Constant: every admitted venture is a venture of Huerta Group LLC.

classification.description: Approved venture classifications. New classes require Founder Office authorization and a schema change.

determination.description: The determinations-register record evidencing admission. Repositories, codebases, domains, ideas, and websites do not create ventures.

regularization.description: True when the venture operated before formal chartering; preserves the historical distinction without rewriting history.

legalEntityStatus.description: FD-V1 invariant: a venture is not an independent company, legal entity, or subsidiary. Legal-form change is a governance decision (FD-V9 stages; Corporate Headquarters action) requiring schema-level authorization to represent.

source.description: Delegated authority is scoped authority derived from parent authority — never independent institutional sovereignty.

reservedParentAuthority.description: Validator-enforced: must include the FD-V1 reserved set (constitutional authority; institutional governance; legal ownership; strategic direction; capital allocation; portfolio governance; public corporate representation).

grant.description: The only approved grants. Sharing occurs only through explicit institutional grant; no capability is shared because it exists in the parent or is technically accessible.

lifecycle.description: Per-dimension status (blueprint §20). No combined status field exists or may be added; no dimension implies another; values are recorded conditions, never created by recording.

legalComplianceReadiness.description: Corporate Headquarters authority. Additional values require authorization; unresolved is never treated as favorable.

graduation.description: FD-V9. Graduation is never automatic and is separate from operational success, age, revenue, scale, and maturity unless the Founder Office later establishes criteria.

successPrinciple.description: FD-V10. Organizational independence is not a success requirement; organizational form is a governance decision, not a venture objective.

publicRepresentation.description: Recorded factual representation postures. Parent-platform representation follows the FD-V4 model (fd-0009): the minimum governed fact set, sourced from institutional-plane authority, within the venture's disclosure and maturity posture; representation precedes linking — no parent-to-venture public link until the venture's official-launch determination or an express pre-launch authorization. The lifecycle publicDisclosureReadiness dimension carries the governed status; postures record facts and never create disclosure authority.

registerTopology.description: FD-V2 register-topology invariants (fd-0008). Constants encode approved doctrine, not new meaning: institutional authority remains singular; operational governance may be distributed; repository location never determines authority — the governing plane of the fact does.

determination.description: The determinations-register record evidencing the governing register-topology determination (FD-V2).
